settings.hero_desc: A set of oversized decorative skeleton keys, 3D-printed in clean white with intricate ornamental bows. A characterful display and photo-prop piece for interiors, events and themed spaces. This price includes a set of all 9 keys.
settings.perso_placeholder: Mention your color, default is white
settings.s1_body: These oversized skeleton keys make playful, eye-catching decor - mounted on a wall, styled on a shelf, or used as a photo and event prop. Each is 3D-printed with detailed ornamental heads and can be produced in a range of sizes and finishes to suit your space or theme.
settings.case_body: Pico is an Event Company who wanted these unqiue keys for their client opening ceremony. Instead of using a normal key, they decided to make a custom key prop that would look eye catchy for the opening ceremony. Each key designed for a different lock to open.
settings.case_quote: Audience were surprised when the director walked on the stage with these keys during the opening ceremony.
settings.prov_p: There is something timeless about an ornate old key. Scaled up and reimagined as decor, it becomes a sculptural piece full of character and curiosity. Keys are the symbol of opportunity
